label: BW-style / CLI-adapted

rubric_scores.evidence: Columns and primary beams are simple eight-vertex boxes, not flange-and-web I-sections. The roof is a plain slab without corrugation; representative assembly connections are not legible in the delivered hero.
Foreground conveyors, intermediate upright tank, rear raised machinery, and left window wall preserve the broad reference organization with generally plausible relative sizes.
Four substantial housings sit on a supported deck, but their hero appearance is flat pale gray without the required brushed stainless response.
Yellow guarding and three stairs exist, but uninterrupted platform rails cross the stair arrivals, obstructing usable access. The yellow material also lacks wear or surface variation.
Utilities comprise two bent runs and one straight header with rods. They lack a dense process-pipe network, readable reducers, and wrinkled reflective insulation.
The floor-standing cylindrical tank has formed heads and legs, but its nozzles are plain cylinders without flanges. Its uniform turquoise-green finish lacks the specified worn dark-green character.
Substantial blue conveyor runs have supports, side rails, and transverse rollers. The purported drives are featureless boxes, with no identifiable motor, gearbox, or equivalent drive assembly.

Green flooring has broad specular highlights and systems remain color-separated. However, dominant daylight through the side windows and linear supplementary lighting are not clearly established, and stainless versus foil reflection treatment is missing.

The elevated oblique hero viewpoint jointly shows the hall frame, foreground conveyors, central tank, raised machines, and simplified overhead utilities. Perspective is natural and broad spatial relationships remain recognizable.

The editable project opens, uses Cycles and AgX, and has no external image textures. Nevertheless, the original hero has conspicuous uncontrolled noise; native rendering uses 16 samples with Cycles denoising disabled.
The original delivery is a valid, fully decoded PNG, but measures 512×267 instead of 3840×2160.

dimension_scores.evidence: The main scene and production zones correspond recognizably, but machinery and utilities are heavily simplified.
Major objects have supports, but blocked stair arrivals, slender framing, and rudimentary utility attachments weaken installation plausibility.
Yellow guarding, blue conveyors, green tank and floor, and dark framing are distinct; pale boxlike machines lose much of the target character.
Primitive housings, faceted vessels and ducts, sparse fittings, and heavy original-image noise produce an unfinished visualization.
Foreground, intermediate, platform, and side-wall relationships are retained, though spacing is more open and regular than the target.
Equipment, stairs, tank, and hall have broadly credible relative sizes; thin long-span members and sparse conveyor rollers reduce industrial credibility.
Soft shadows and floor highlights provide depth, but daylight direction is weak, metallic finishes are insufficiently differentiated, and noise is prominent.
Major object categories are present, while structural connection details, dense utilities, insulation texture, flanges, and recognizable drive details are missing.

same_model_bias_limit: Research and independent judge use Astra; separate sessions do not establish human independence.
